liffraedi-extended.label: Líffræði + aðliggjandi orðasöfn (Biology + adjacent subjects)
liffraedi-extended._note: MEASURED 2026-07-26 against the 2262 OpenStax Biology 2e headwords, not guessed. Adding every adjacent collection to LIFORD raised authoritative coverage only 48% -> 54%: the marginal value is concentrated almost entirely in ERFDAFR and ONAEMI. Counts are from /d/api/es/agg/dictionaries/ (82 collections; names at /d/api/dictionaries/?limit=1000) — those are true totals, while /api/es/terms/ caps at 10,000 (ES result cap), which is why LIFORD needs per-letter fetching.
liffraedi-extended._warning: ⚠️ COLLECTIONS DISAGREE, AND MORE COLLECTIONS MEANS MORE CONFLICT. Of the 283 book headwords found in more than one collection, 111 (39%) have different Icelandic — e.g. antibiotic LIFORD='fúkalyf' vs ERFDAFR='sýklalyf'; antigen LIFORD='mótefnavaki' vs ERFDAFR/ONAEMI='vaki'; autoimmunity LIFORD='sjálfsnæmi' vs ONAEMI='sjálfsofnæmi'. Keep fkdictionary on every imported term and resolve precedence per domain. A blind union silently picks whichever loaded last.

collections.label: Líforðasafn (10,031) — 1167 hits, 887 of them unique to it
Erfðafræði / genetics (1,163) — 271 hits, 45 unique. Uses RNA/DNA not RKS/DKS, and completes the 'Nth stigs bygging' structure series. Worth it.
Ónæmisfræði / immunology (943, 794 bilingual) — 109 hits, 24 unique. Worth it for the immunology chapters.
Faraldsfræði / epidemiology (269) — 8 hits, 2 unique. Marginal, but tiny and free.
Lýðheilsufræði / public health (244, 202 bilingual) — 5 hits, 2 unique. Marginal.
Umhverfisfræði / environmental science (32) — 1 hit. Kept only because it costs one request.

_measured_zero_value.PODDUR: Pöddur / insects (797) — ⚠️ LATIN↔ICELANDIC ONLY (e.g. 'Vanessa atalanta' -> 'aðmíráll'). NO English side at all, so it yields 0 bilingual pairs and can never serve an EN->IS glossary. Verified by fetching.
_measured_zero_value.RISAEDLUR: Risaeðlur / dinosaurs (331) — ⚠️ same: Latin↔Icelandic only, 0 bilingual pairs.
_measured_zero_value.SJODYR: Sjávardýr (985, 838 bilingual) — fetched fine but contributed 0 authoritative hits against this book's headwords. Species names, not concept terminology.
_measured_zero_value.PLANTA: Nöfn háplöntuætta (478, 251 bilingual; 13-language incl. EN) — 0 authoritative hits. Family names, not concept terminology.

_deliberately_not_fetched.LAEKN: Læknisfræði / medicine — 33,593. The one genuinely promising addition left, for the anatomy/physiology chapters. Needs per-letter fetching and would dominate a merge; add deliberately.
_deliberately_not_fetched.FLORA: Plöntuheiti — 11,532. Species names; expect the same zero yield as SJODYR/PLANTA.
_deliberately_not_fetched.FUGLAR: Fuglaheiti — 2,747. Species names; likely Latin-keyed like PODDUR.
